title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta58

Polish initial setup, managed Schedule controls, zone cleanup and documentation before the 0.4.3 stable release.

### Setup
- Skip the redundant mower-selection screen when private-cloud login leaves exactly one unconfigured mower; continue directly to the official Smart Home OAuth step.
- Keep the mower picker when two or more unconfigured mowers genuinely remain, and keep the existing manual-serial fallback when no mower is listed.

### Navimower Schedule
- Add a Home Assistant **Reset schedule progress** button after Navimower Schedule has been configured.
- The button calls the same proven scheduler reset path as `navimower.reset_schedule`: it clears the current round/queue position and retained scheduler ownership without sending a mower command.
- The button is unavailable while the mower is mowing or returning, matching the existing reset safety rule.
- Schedule Off/On remains reversible pause/resume; destructive reset remains an explicit separate action.

### Map and zone entities
- Remove stale Home Assistant zone-sensor registry rows when a freshly decoded, versioned map proves that their vendor zone IDs no longer exist.
- This cleans up orphaned Coverage, Area, Mowed area, Last mowed and Last completed entities left after Navimow merge/split/recreate map edits.
- Cleanup is deliberately conservative: missing, empty or unversioned map data never deletes zone entities, and historical mowing/session data is not removed.

### Documentation
- Replace the integration README with a current 0.4.3-oriented guide covering setup, Options Flow, current-cycle rendering, Custom Areas, Navimower Schedule, actions, regional routing, diagnostics and Map Card compatibility.
- Document the Navimow Off-limit restriction for Custom Areas that span separate zones: temporarily merge the required mowing zones first, capture/import the Custom Area, then restore the original zones.
- Document that Navimower Map Card 0.3.5 requires Navimower integration 0.4.3 or newer.
